title: Möbius-Invariant Goodness-of-Fit Tests for the Spherical Cauchy Model
summary: We introduce a class of goodness-of-fit tests for the spherical Cauchy model on the unit hypersphere. The proposed procedures exploit the invariance of the spherical Cauchy family under Möbius transformations: after estimating the parameter by the sample Möbius mean, the observations are transformed to approximate spherical uniformity, and a projection-based uniformity statistic is applied to the resulting sample. We show that, under mild conditions, the resulting tests are exactly distribution-free under the null hypothesis, so that exact critical values can be arbitrarily well approximated…
